name: Corrosion & Degradation of Materials
summary: Explains why and how metals corrode and other materials degrade, and the engineering methods used to prevent it.

topics.name: Economic and safety cost of corrosion
Corrosion thermodynamics and kinetics: mixed-potential theory and Evans diagrams
Galvanic corrosion and the galvanic series
Localised corrosion: pitting, crevice and intergranular corrosion; sensitisation
Hydrogen damage and hydrogen embrittlement mechanisms
Atmospheric, marine, soil and microbiologically influenced corrosion
Corrosion protection: materials selection, design, inhibitors, coatings and cathodic protection
Corrosion testing and monitoring (salt spray, polarisation, EIS)
Degradation of polymers: UV, oxidation, hydrolysis, swelling and environmental stress cracking
